author: Karl Guttag
description: Last month at MicroLED and ARVR Connect, I gave a "Master Class" on the conference's first day. I tried to cram about 2 hours of content into a 1-hour presentation. I presented on the trends I saw in optical see-through (OST) AR in 2026. With the conference's permission to use the video, I decided to turn my presentation into a series of articles.
title: AR in 2026 Year In Review Presentation (Part 1: AR Challenges)
